name: SILL
verdict: SILL (Société Industrielle Laitière du Léon), of the Breton group SILL Entreprises, founded in 1962 by the Falc'hun and León families, which calls itself a longstanding family business. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: SILL Entreprises calls itself a family business; the company register lists Sébastien Floch as Président de SAS with Tristan Falc'hun and Henri León as Directeurs Généraux. No state or fund stake found → none.
